back_translation: In the thirtieth year, the fourth month, on the fifth day of that month, while I was among the exiles by the River Kebar, the heavens opened and I saw various visions from God.
On the fifth day of that month — it was the fifth year of the captivity of King Jehoiachin —
The word of the LORD came truly to Ezekiel the priest, son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Kebar, and the hand of the LORD came upon him there.

I looked, and behold, there was a windstorm coming from the north, a great cloud with blazing flickering fire, and a bright radiance around that cloud; from the center of the cloud something that looked like gleaming metal shone out from the midst of the fire.
And from the midst of that fire there was a form resembling four living creatures. Their appearance was like this: they had a form resembling a human.
Each one had four faces and four wings.
Their legs were straight, the soles of their feet were like the soles of a calf's feet, and they gleamed and sparkled like polished bronze.
Under the wings on their four sides they had human hands, and all four of them had faces and wings.
Their wings touched one another. When they moved they did not turn back; each one went straight ahead.
The form of their faces was like this: they had a human face, and all four had a lion's face on the right, an ox's face on the left, and also an eagle's face.
Their faces and wings spread out above; each had two wings touching the wing of the one beside it, and two wings covering its body.
Each went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they went; when they moved they did not turn back.
The form of those living creatures looked like burning coals of fire, like torches; the fire moved back and forth among the creatures, shining brightly, and lightning flashed out from that fire.
Those living creatures darted back and forth like a flash of lightning.
As I looked at those living creatures, behold, there was a wheel on the ground beside the living creatures with their four faces, one wheel for each.
Those wheels, in appearance and structure, gleamed like tarshish stone; all four had the same form, that is, they looked like a wheel within a wheel.
When they moved, those wheels could go in any of the four directions without turning.
Their rims were high and awesome, and the four rims were full of eyes all around.
When the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them; and when the living creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose too.
Wherever the spirit would go, they went, and the wheels rose beside them, because the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

When the living creatures moved, the wheels moved; when the living creatures stood still, the wheels stood still; and when the living creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose beside them, because the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
Above the heads of the living creatures was something that looked like an expanse, gleaming like awesome ice-crystal, spread out above their heads.
Under that expanse their wings stretched straight toward one another; each had two wings covering its body on both sides.

When they moved, I heard the sound of their wings like the sound of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a tumultuous sound like the sound of an army; when they stood still they let down their wings.
And there was a sound coming from above the expanse that was over their heads; when they stood still they let down their wings.

Above the expanse that was over their heads there was something that looked like a throne made of sapphire, and above that which looked like a throne was one who looked like the form of a human, enthroned high above.

I saw something that looked like gleaming metal, like fire enclosing it all around; from what looked like his waist upward, and from what looked like his waist downward, I saw something that looked like fire, and there was bright radiance around him.

The bright radiance around it was like a rainbow that appears in the clouds on a rainy day. That was the appearance of what looked like the glory of the LORD. When I saw it, I bowed my face down to the ground, and I heard a voice speaking.
